name: hud_ui_zrd_widget_ex17c_enable_child_at_index
description: HudUiZrdWidgetEx17C::EnableChildAtIndex enables an in-range option child and dispatches the child's RefreshState slot.
known_limits: isolated VC5 byte comparison now passes for 0x409010, but tier B/S marker acceptance remains blocked until the HudUiZrdWidgetEx17C owner and no-authored-globals data gate are accepted.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x409010 validates signed upper-bound check against optionCount at offset 0x14c, option lookup from options at offset 0x150, modeOrEnabled write at child offset 0xc4, and indirect call through child ftable slot 0x78.

The native smoke verifies the in-range child modeOrEnabled write, the no-op out-of-range path, the selector ftable slot 0x60 mapping to EnableChildAtIndex, and the child item ftable slot 0x78 dispatch to RefreshState.
